title: Everyday Food
origin: Original content created directly in this collection repository on 20 November 2026. Steven's gym idea: food plants, scout and camping cookbooks, why bitter and sweet taste good together, and the anatomy of the tongue and its relationship to smell. His placement, decided the same day: a main-hub room standing next to The Survival Guide, with links between them in both directions. The room opens with an audit of the famous tongue map (Hanig 1901, Boring 1942), teaches flavour as taste plus retronasal smell, runs a bitter-and-sweet balance bench, teaches six food plants as identification discipline under the standing rule - never eat a wild plant on a webpage's say-so - counts Dutch-oven coals off the published chart, and closes with the chemistry of browning. The banner is AI-generated art made for this room the same day.
